correctness.rationale: A bounded harmonic measure majorant of |y| on the half-strip gives the universal bound; strong interior strictness follows from both-sign Brownian exit distribution. Fourier separation yields coefficients 2/lambda_j^2 and the exact profile. The sinh map identifies the disk with the half-strip, gives a conformal extremizer at each center, and strictness shows equality iff its disk coordinate map is inner. Termwise derivatives and uniform expansion of cosh/cos yield the claimed finite off-center slope and centered logarithmic crossover. The standalone numerical test independently checks the exact profile against the conformal boundary integral at 15 parameter pairs; numerical samples are not the proof.

value.rationale: The exact sharp first absolute moment under a positivity and imaginary-range restriction is a natural critical endpoint of recent p>1 harmonic-conjugate estimates, whose linear constants become infinite at p=1. The full two-parameter finite-mean profile, classification of all extremizers as inner maps and uniform logarithmic corner crossover quantify a real change between nonzero-imaginary-centre and centred regimes. The frontier is attained for every admissible parameter; not an arbitrary slice or table recomputation.
